dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: ...Oh. You gave me a real fright... Who are you? *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you... sleeping with your eyes open?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: I was... until you woke me up!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: This is an act, you know. Something to fool my family, so that this night's rendezvous will not be exposed... Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: It's very impolite to wake someone when they're sleeping, so please refrain from doing it again. You won't find me to be as agreeable as my father... *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: My family name is Goth, get the picture?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: My father is the general manager of the Goth Grand Hotel.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Don't be fooled by his Mr. Nice Guy act — he's being completely obstinate and unreasonable on the matter of my marriage!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: That's why all I can do in the middle of the night is to... to— Wait a moment, you haven't been sent by him to get me talking, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Go away, get out of here. I am wide awake, I'm not in the slightest bit sleepy... *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: I dare not even think of it. When the storm came, a huge rock came hurtling towards me. Fortunately, it missed, smashing into the ground next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: At that instant, all I could think about was my girlfriend. That was when I realized that she means the world to me.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Even if my father opposes us being together and tries to meddle in our affairs, our relationship will survive!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Yes. We will be together. I just... need some time to persuade my father...
